# General Instructions for GitHub Repository
- All code should be written in English.
- Follow best practices for code quality and documentation.
- Ensure code is modular and reusable.
- Include comments to explain complex logic.
- Use consistent naming conventions for variables and functions.
- Console commands should be compatible bash environments.
- Do not use backslash in paths '\' only slash '/'.
- Stack bun.js and typescript.
- Artifacts and reports generated by AI should be written to the /research folder.
- Do not set private keys, tokens or sensitive information in the code or console commands. All data must be taken in environment variables.
